benefits.name: Delta Stays Credit
benefits.description: Up to $100 in statement credits per calendar year on new prepaid hotel or vacation rental bookings made through Delta Stays (delta.com/stays).

benefits.name: Delta Flight Credit
benefits.description: $200 Delta eCredit issued after $10,000+ in eligible purchases in a calendar year. Valid for Delta-marketed flights; expires 1 year from issuance.
